Details

The Marseille Handbag is the epitome of elegance and luxury. Crafted with a richly textured design and impeccable high-quality materials, this high-end piece radiates sophistication. With a comfortable handle and a detachable, adjustable strap, this bag offers versatility and functionality without compromising style. The spacious interior is thoughtfully designed to fit all your essentials, while the refined structure makes it easy to pair with countless outfits. 

  • Materials: Genuine Leather + Polyester
  • Handbag Size: 28.5cm (11.2 inches) x 11cm (4.3 inches) x 22cm (8.7 inches) (L*W*H)
  • Handbag Type: Handbag
What Fits in the Bag
  • Wallet
  • Phone
  • Keys
  • Sunglasses with case
  • Water bottle (16-20oz)
  • Compact umbrella
  • Hand sanitizer
  • iPad Mini
  • Windows tablets (Surface Go series)
  • E-readers like Kindle Oasis or Paperwhite
  • Standard iPad (24.8cm x 17.9cm) - fits lengthwise but uses most of your bag's width
  • iPad Air (24.7cm x 17.8cm) - similar tight fit
  • Most 10-inch Android tablets
  • Lipstick, lip balm, makeup compact
  • Hand lotion
  • Perfume or fragrance roller
  • Phone charger cable (not bulky wall adapter)
  • Earbuds or small headphones
  • Portable battery pack
